articles.title: Keely Hodgkinson shows off Catwoman style to steal Athlos London event
articles.summary: Briton destroys 800m field in hooded black bodysuit. Mill Hill event more like a rave than an athletics meeting. Athlos arrived in London promising that its all-female spin on track and field would be radically different.
body: Throughout the night the sound of the bassline from the aptly named DJ Trauma, who was given pride of place in front of the main stage, carried enough power to make eardrums bleed.
There was dancing and frequent shouts to the crowd to make some noise. And, between all that, some athletics broke out.
Some of it was pretty decent too. Hodgkinson providing the abiding image of the night, with a bodysuit that brought to mind Cathy Freeman at the Sydney 2000 Olympics.

As she was introduced, the stadium MC told the crowd: “Wait until she comes around the corner, she looks bad, bad, bad. In a custom Nike custom suit, Keely Hodgkinson!” Athletics sometimes resembles a vicarage tea party. This was more like a rave. Mill Hill has rarely seen anything like it.

articles.title: Brentford blitz Chelsea as Fábio Carvalho caps stunning second-half display
articles.summary: Those early season thoughts that Chelsea might be the team best placed to challenge Arsenal are beginning to look over-optimistic. The two chaotic wins with which they began the season were always difficult to read: they might have been useful points picked up on the way to a more solid structure…
body: Brentford’s first home win over Chelsea since 1938 means they remain unbeaten, third in the table, coherent and disciplined. The comparison is impossible not to draw: as one side flails in an orgy of structured spending, their far less wealthy neighbours thrive with a clear plan and sense of direction.

Such is the state of perpetual flux at Chelsea that the usual homilies about the benefits of stability always seem a little redundant when applied to them. With 11 new signings this summer maintaining the sense of the club as a trading hub, learning the names of everybody in the dressing room has probably been a greater priority than worrying too much about boardroom wrangling but, still, their first game since Todd Boehly and Mark Walter agreed to sell their 12.8% stakes in the club to the major shareholder Clearlake Capital felt significant. At the very least, a more harmonious boardroom should be beneficial.

articles.title: Littler survives scare to progress at World Series Finals
articles.summary: World number one Luke Littler survives a first-round scare to overcome Danny Noppert in a thrilling World Series of Darts Finals match in Amsterdam.
body: The 19-year-old, seeking his second World Series Finals victory after 2024, recently whitewashed the Dutchman, who is a former UK Open champion, 6-0 on his way to winning the Czech Darts Open.
There would be no repeat here as Noppert won three straight legs to take a 3-1 lead.
Having levelled the match at 3-3, Littler turned to the crowd and tapped his ears in response to boos.
Despite the teenager then busting his score, Noppert failed to take advantage and retake the lead.

articles.title: Women’s Super League: Lauren Hemp hits double as Manchester City see off lively Liverpool
articles.summary: Manchester City continued their winning start to the new Women’s Super League season but the defending champions needed a 90th-minute own goal from Grace Fisk to help them edge past an ever-improving Liverpool side after an entertaining game in which Lauren Hemp scored twice.
body: Fisk inadvertently turned Grace Clinton’s dangerous cross into her own net to put City 3-2 up and then – with Liverpool searching for an equaliser and committing players forward deep in stoppage time – Hemp added another on the counterattack to make it 4-2 and widen the margin of victory, but that slightly masked how well the visitors had played.
Gareth Taylor – against his former side – will have taken significant encouragement from his Liverpool team’s performance, on a night when they made the league leaders dig deep.

“Playing that way, we believe we’ll win a lot of games this season,” Taylor told Sky Sports, as he praised his team’s effort. “What you saw was a more improved version of what we were towards the end of last season.”

That certainly seemed the case. Nevertheless, the result ensured that City, who had already been the only WSL side who held a 100% winning record after the opening two rounds of games and now will certainly stay top of the table for at least another week, have still not dropped any points in home league fixtures since Andrée Jeglertz took charge in the summer of 2025.

articles.title: Trent Alexander-Arnold recalled by England but with a warning from Thomas Tuchel
articles.summary: Real Madrid player must help improve defensive solidity. Scott, Hall, Lewis-Skelly and Calvert-Lewin selected. Thomas Tuchel has told Trent Alexander-Arnold he must bring defensive solidity to the England squad after giving him a surprise recall for the upcoming Nations League matches.
body: The head coach has selected the Real Madrid right-back only once before – for the games against Andorra and Senegal in June last year. Tuchel made headlines when he did so by urging Alexander-Arnold to focus on the defensive side of his game or risk a slip that could undermine the team’s World Cup campaign.

Tuchel used him as a 64th-minute substitute against Andorra and Alexander-Arnold was out of the picture by the time England went to North America for the tournament. He is now back, despite starting only three of Madrid’s seven matches this season and largely going under the radar with his performances. Tuchel’s message to him has not changed.
“He has to, it’s necessary,” Tuchel said when asked whether Alexander-Arnold offered enough defensively. “My conviction is that he will but he has no choice.”

Tuchel continues to see Alexander-Arnold, who is famed for the range of his passing, as a right-back rather than a midfielder. The head coach has previously said he has Tino Livramento and Jarell Quansah ahead of Alexander-Arnold in the right-back pecking order. He has named both of them in the squad for the games against Spain (home), Czechia (home and away) and Croatia (away).

articles.title: Sheeraz withdraws from next bout & gives up WBO title
articles.summary: Hamzah Sheeraz has withdrawn from a proposed bout with Janibek Alimkhanuly and relinquished his WBO super-middleweight title, the sanctioning body has confirmed.
body: The British fighter was mandated by the organisation to face the Kazakhstan boxer, who is the WBO's number one challenger for the title.

A purse bid was held on Thursday for the right to host the bout, which Sheeraz's promoters Queensberry won with a bid of $1,001,809 (£747,903). Top Rank were the only other bidders, but fell short with their $850,000 (£634, 569) offer.
The British promoters had planned to stage the bout on either 28 November or 5 December with London, Birmingham and New York proposed locations.
But the WBO confirmed on Friday night Sheeraz, 27, had withdrawn from the bout.

articles.title: Brentford batter Chelsea to undo Alonso's promising start
articles.summary: Brentford exposed Chelsea's defensive problems to inflict a damaging 3-0 defeat on Friday that gives Xabi Alonso plenty to ponder over a three-week international break.
body: After a promising start to life under the former Real Madrid coach, Chelsea have picked up just one point from their last three league games.
Goals from Jaidon Anthony, Igor Thiago and Fabio Carvalho took unbeaten Brentford above their west London neighbours and up to third in the table.
"I have this unbelievable calm around that team because I trust them. It's nice to see it come to fruition," said Brentford boss Keith Andrews.
Chelsea had quickly earned the reputation as the Premier League's great entertainers under Alonso with their opening four games containing 19 goals.

articles.title: McIlroy in mix heading into weekend at Wentworth
articles.summary: Rory McIlroy stays in contention with a five-under 67 to sit four strokes behind second-round leader Ryan Gerard at the BMW PGA Championship at Wentworth.
body: The Northern Irishman made three birdies in his opening five holes and recovered from dropped shots on the eighth and 16th by picking up four strokes on the back nine, including birdies on the 17th and 18th holes.
Reigning Masters champion McIlroy's hopes of winning a record-equalling eighth Race to Dubai title were also buoyed by the withdrawal of Patrick Reed after nine holes.
The American, who currently leads the standings on the DP World Tour, had been well placed after the first round but was forced to retire through injury while nine-over par for Friday's round.
"Unfortunately he's pulled out this week, which gives me an opportunity to try to claw back some ground that I lost last week in Ireland," said McIlroy, who is at eight under overall.

body: The Chicago Bears are sitting pretty with a 1-0 record after their first game of the season, where they totally routed the Carolina Panthers, 59-37. Now, the team faces a familiar NFC North foe: the Minnesota Vikings.

Quarterback Caleb Williams is a big part of the Bears' rebuild. He's been working with new head coach Ben Johnson, of course, and now, this duo is really making magic together. During the team's season opener, Williams had 334 total yards and four touchdowns.
Now, Week 2 in the NFL is officially here, and Williams and the Bears are getting ready.
On Friday, ESPN released a feature about the upcoming games. In it, they note that Vikings defensive coordinator Brian Flores is a challenge for Williams and the Bears.

articles.title: Arteta: Dowman could go out on loan in future
articles.summary: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta has not ruled out loaning out Max Dowman in the future and says the club evaluates the 16-year-old sensation's progress every six months.
body: Dowman continued his rise by starting and scoring twice in Arsenal's Carabao Cup win over Ipswich this week. After the game, Gunners midfielder Mikel Merino compared the young teenager to Barcelona and Spain star Lamine Yamal.
But those 90 minutes at Portman Road have been Dowman's only minutes of the season, and he did not make Arsenal's matchday squad in the wins over Aston Villa and Sunderland.
"We haven't really listened to any of the [loan] possibilities because we were clear that we want to have him in the squad, that we wanted him to be part of the pre-season," Arteta said.
"I'm going to start to see where we are from there. We will evaluate every six months where we are, what is the best thing for him to do and from there make the right decisions.

articles.summary: Luke Littler, the world's No 1 darts player, has won all the major darts tournaments so far in 2026, and is well on his way to becoming the third man to complete a clean sweep of ranking and non-ranking titles in a single year.
body: Littler has the World Championship, World Masters, UK Open and World Matchplay titles under his belt already to add to an already crowded 2026 trophy cabinet that also includes the Premier League and World Cup.
He now has to win five more titles to make more history, so Sky Sports analyses Littler's exact path to achieving that historic feat...

Littler's next hurdle on the journey to the clean sweep continues this weekend at the World Series of Darts Finals. He beat Danny Noppert in a dramatic first round contest where the crowd jeered him and will play Nathan Aspinall next in the second round on Saturday.

Michael van Gerwen is the reigning champion, having beaten Littler 11-7 in front of a partisan home crowd in Amsterdam, but the Englishman does have a World Series title under his belt already, having beaten Michael Smith 11-4 in 2024.
